name: ForEach-Object { }
summary: Runs a PowerShell script block for each object ($_ is the current object) and passes on what it returns.
action: runs a script block on each object
description: Pipeline glue for reshaping values, such as pulling the executable path out of a service command line. The script block is PowerShell code and is passed as written; Command Lens checks that brackets and quotes balance. % is the short alias.

params.label: Script block
params.desc: PowerShell code run once per object; $_ is the object.

presets.name: Executable path from a service command line
presets.opsec: Pipe Get-CimInstance Win32_Service into this; follow with Sort-Object -Unique and Get-AuthenticodeSignature.

presets.name: Scheduled task: name, action and run-as user
Connection with the owning process path
